name: gamez_zbd_node_index_to_ptr
description: GameZ_ZBD::NodeIndexToPtr maps serialized node indexes to live zClass node slots, returning null for negative indexes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass ZBD/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4543d0 validates negative-index null handling and zClass_NodeFreeListSlot pointer calculation from g_zClass_NodeArray using the 0xc4 node slot stride.
The native zClass ZBD leaf smoke verifies -1 returns null and index 1 resolves to the expected g_zClass_NodeArray slot's node.
